name: Duty Missions

note: Limite diário de ganho de 1.000.000 Kinah. No limite entra o debuff Item Drop and Obtain Restriction.
Daily gain limit of 1,000,000 Kinah. At the limit you get the Item Drop and Obtain Restriction debuff.

name: Attendance

name: Shugo Festival

name: Ascension Trial
note: 3 entradas por semana.
3 entries a week.

name: Abyss time

name: Abyss Supply: Weekly Requests
note: Pedidos semanais do Abyss entregues.
Abyss weekly requests delivered.

name: Abyss Entry Stone missions
note: Season Missions > Abyss > Weekly: “Spend 1 Hour in the Abyss” e “Defeat the Boss Guardian Lord Nahma Once”. Cada uma dá Abyss Entry Stone (desde o patch de 14/out/2026). O Nahma aparece sexta e domingo às 21:00.

Season Missions > Abyss > Weekly: “Spend 1 Hour in the Abyss” and “Defeat the Boss Guardian Lord Nahma Once”. Each one gives Abyss Entry Stones (since the 14 Oct 2026 patch). Nahma shows up on Friday and Sunday at 21:00.

name: Ariel crystals (Substance Morph)
note: Daevanion Crystal: Ariel feitos no Substance Morph (Special > Daevanion): 100 Ariel Fragments do modo Hard de Krao Cave e Draupnir para cada um, até 30 por personagem. Não zera. O que sobrar de fragmento vira 5 Enhance Stones cada.

Daevanion Crystal: Ariel made at Substance Morph (Special > Daevanion): 100 Ariel Fragments from Krao Cave and Draupnir on Hard for each one, up to 30 per character. It does not reset. Spare fragments turn into 5 Enhance Stones each.

name: Resurrection Spiritstone for Kinah (event)
note: Evento Rise to the Challenge: Shop > Wind Breeze Merchants vende Resurrection Spiritstone (Season 1) por Kinah, 30 por 25.000 e mais 30 por 50.000, por servidor e por semana. Some sozinho quando o evento acabar (15/dez).

Rise to the Challenge event: Shop > Wind Breeze Merchants sells Resurrection Spiritstone (Season 1) for Kinah, 30 at 25,000 and 30 more at 50,000, per server and per week. It goes away by itself when the event ends (15 Dec).

name: Duty Commands (bought scrolls)
note: Pergaminhos de Command comprados: 12 na capital e 5 de cada grau em cada raiz do Lower Abyss.
Command scrolls bought: 12 in the capital and 5 of each grade at each Lower Abyss root.

name: Arena
note: Arena of Solitude (1v1) e Arena of Cooperation (5v5): Victory Reward em 30 vitórias e Participation Reward em 10 partidas, em cada uma.
Arena of Solitude (1v1) and Arena of Cooperation (5v5): Victory Reward at 30 wins and Participation Reward at 10 matches, on each.

name: Battlefield
note: Arena of Tactics: Victory Reward em 3 vitórias e Participation Reward em 3 partidas.
Arena of Tactics: Victory Reward at 3 wins and Participation Reward at 3 matches.

name: Daeva Pass EXP

name: Abyss Corridors
